issues.title: [03/Core] Implement bounded event queues and Win32 worker wakeups
issues.goal: Route worker completions and commands to sleeping owners without polling or lost wakeups.
issues.constraints: Event { uint32_t type, generation; uint64_t id; fixed payload/handle } uses a bounded MPSC queue for WinHTTP/worker completions; per-lane SPSC is allowed only for proven single producers. issues.title: [07/Protocol] Implement CNG DH, AP signature verification and seekable AES-CTR
issues.goal: Match Spotify cryptographic byte conventions using Windows primitives and fail closed on unauthenticated APs.
issues.constraints: Expose crypto_dh_init/export_public/derive, crypto_ap_verify_signature, crypto_hmac_sha1, crypto_sha256 and crypto_ctr_xor_at(key, iv, uint64_t file_offset, bytes, length). RAW_SECRET is little-endian: reverse then remove big-endian leading zeroes to match reference before HMAC. Implement CTR with AES-ECB(counter)+XOR, no padding, 128-bit big-endian carry and partial-block handling; do not request a nonexistent CNG CTR mode. Caller-owned contexts and bounded CNG handles; SecureZeroMemory secrets on all exits. Also expose crypto_sha1 for Login5/clienttoken hashcash; test plain SHA-1 known-answer vectors separately from HMAC.
issues.verification: Use independent DH leading-zero/public/shared vectors, AP signed/tampered gs, HMAC transcript vectors, standard AES vectors and random-access split CTR at offsets 0/1/15/16/17/166/167 and counter carries. Inject provider errors and assert no leaked handles. Verify 768-bit custom parameters work on supported Windows.

Record total/peak resident working set, private working set/commit, CPU time raw and percent, render/wake counts, arena high-water, owned/shared GPU memory, handles and DLL imports. Required Release targets: full app <20,000,000 resident bytes, headless <8,000,000, executable <2,000,000 bytes, true cold startup <30 ms under stated conditions. No EmptyWorkingSet, hidden process or excluding loaded libraries. Literal zero CPU while decoding is impossible: 0.0% is the displayed rounding target; report exact CPU and threshold, enforce no polling and zero idle presents. Separate Debug ASan from Release measurements. Include dependency license/source manifest and removal of unused codecs/backends/runtime shader compilation.

## Definition of Done / Verification

Run full ASan CTest suite with balanced allocations/handles, Release benchmarks for idle/paused/playing/scroll/10k filter/seek/gapless/art churn/device loss and offline cold start. Check /W4 /WX or -Wall -Wextra -Werror and no C++ files/msvcprt/stdc++ imports. Publish raw results, reproducible commands and threshold failures. Do not close if metrics fail or mandatory live integration is unverified; document hardware-dependent skips separately.

Targeted verification: Run the complete Debug ASan suite before the Release benchmark.

Release benchmark: `cmake -B build-rel -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release` then `cmake --build build-rel` and `ctest --test-dir build-rel -R "^(bench_release|bench_idle|bench_navigation)$" --output-on-failure`.

All implementation is C17/C23; no C++ translation units or C++ runtime. Keep project modules under 500 lines. No heap allocation in UI layout/render or WASAPI callback. Use owned arenas/handles and explicit full/cancel/error outcomes; never grow silently. Preserve pinned upstream licenses. Add each named test with add_test and the existing strict-warning/ASan build options. Register bench_* only in Release/non-ASan configurations; account, physical-device and optional GPU tests require an explicit opt-in CMake option (labels alone do not exclude tests from default ctest). Deterministic fake-device tests remain enabled in the default ASan suite.

Required correctness commands (x64 developer shell):
```powershell
cmake -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DENABLE_ASAN=ON
cmake --build build
ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure
```
All deterministic tests must pass with zero warnings, ASan errors, and tracked allocation/handle leaks. ASan does not replace race tests or leak accounting. Performance tests use a separate Release build; hardware/account-dependent tests must be explicitly labeled, and a skipped live check is not evidence of compatibility.
